notes: Positive legal label-claim rule for the 22 official Savigny-lès-Beaune Premier Cru climats. The effective specification permits the listed climat names for both white and red wines meeting Premier Cru production conditions.

savigny_bivb_spec_2011.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne
savigny_bivb_spec_2011.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Savigny-lès-Beaune homologué par le décret n°2011-1792 du 5 décembre 2011
savigny_bivb_spec_2011.scope: The effective specification enumerates 22 climat names and authorizes their use under Premier Cru production conditions for white and red still wine.

rules.notes: All 22 enumerated Premier Cru climats are valid for both white and red Savigny-lès-Beaune when the matching Premier Cru production specification is satisfied.
